title: Yitzchak Sechora
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1, folio 28b, Megillah 3:1 and Taanit 4:1, asking Rabbi Yitzchak, whom Hyman identifies as Rabbi Yitzchak Nappacha from the parallel at the end of tractate Soferim, chapter 20. Some read that he asked Rabbi Yehoshua Nappacha; Hyman calls this a printing error.

notes.text: The immediately preceding full name Yitzchak controls the abbreviated R”Y Nappacha. It does not designate Yochanan in this sentence. The complete Berakhot 4:1 paragraph names Sechora asking Rabbi Yitzchak.
